name: tihloh/prefab-logs
description: Standalone, framework-independent structured activity and audit logging for Prefab PHP.

suggest.ext-pdo: Required only when using Prefab's built-in PDO/database-backed log repository.
suggest.tihloh/prefab-database: Optional shared/named database manager with automatic Prefab integration.
suggest.tihloh/prefab-auth: Optional actor provider for automatic current-user attribution.
suggest.tihloh/prefab-users: Optional user name resolution for human-friendly logs.
